parts.prompt_markdown:
It is given that there is no resistance to the bobsled's motion.

Find its speed when it reaches the bottom of the slope.

It is given instead that the coefficient of friction between the bobsled and the slope is $0.03$.

Find the time that it takes for the bobsled to reach the bottom of the slope.

skills: Use energy conservation when resistance is zero
Use work against friction to find final speed or time using constant acceleration
methods: Case (a): Apply conservation of mechanical energy between top and bottom to find speed
Case (b): Convert friction using F_f = μmg cosθ, find acceleration from resultant force down slope, then use constant-acceleration kinematics to get time
subtopics: Kinetic energy and gravitational potential energy
